listingIdentity: research-weekly-loader listingId (provider listing id or SEC binding canonical id); issuerId = securityId; no ticker-only identity

caseSelection.method: Hash sample from the frame (not hand-picked): smallest sha256("V10-STUDIES-REPLAY-SAMPLE-1.0.0|seed=20261028|" + securityId)

availability.decision: Signal/pattern reads weekly closes up to and including the signal week (engine detect/featuresAt).
availability.entry: Close of the next observed calendar week (entryDelayBars = 1, engine NEXT_OBSERVED_WEEK_CLOSE model).
availability.exit: Time exit after h observed calendar weeks; any missing calendar week in the path censors the outcome (engine SESSION_GAP).

benchmark.rule: SPY price return between the same entry and exit dates; events without both SPY dates are excluded from the SPY endpoint and counted.

uncertainty.pooled: research-validation.inferTemporalBlockMean: circular calendar-block bootstrap over the study calendar (all weeks 2000-2025 incl. zero-event weeks; all listings of a week move together = clustering by date), basic centered interval, two-sided p.
uncertainty.persistence: Per sampled listing with >= 2 completed events in each chronological half (split at the listing's median event index): Spearman rank correlation (research-studies.rankCorrelation) between first-half and second-half mean BASE_RATE_EXCESS; p from Fisher z with sqrt(n-3) (approximate; cross-sectional dependence not modelled).

multipleTesting.definition: 3 endpoints x 2 horizons + persistence x 2 horizons, Holm over 8

separation: Rule-based replay study, separate from the descriptive single-stock view and from any hand-picked example.
dependence: D1 events are, by construction, the above-40w-line events of PATTERN_EVIDENCE restricted to the sample; D1 is not independent of D2.

survivorship.note: Loader ran without listingLifecycleEvidence: every listing in the frame is a current survivor; delisted issuers are absent, so with/without-delisted and censoring bounds cannot be computed. Results are conditional on survival to the data date.
